newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada Aug department store sales rise on month.
newsitem.headline: Canada Aug department store sales rise on month.

text.p: Canadian department stores sales rose a seasonally adjusted revised 1.1 percent in August from July to C$1.21 billion, Statistics Canada said on Thursday.
In unadjusted data, year-over-year sales in August rose 5.5 percent to C$1.2 billion.
Last week, Statistics Canada reported a rise of 1.2 percent in seasonally adjusted department sales in August from July.
Sales at major stores rose 1.5 percent in August to C$526.6 million from the same month a year earlier.
Consumer spending in the discount stores rose 8.8 percent to C$674.0 million from the same month a year earlier.
(For more information from Statistics Canada, contact Mary Beth Garneau, Retail Trade Section, Industry Division, 613-951-9824.)
